siteMetadata.author: Fran Cortez
siteMetadata.bioplus: More than ten years building for the web — accessibility for Walt Disney Parks and Resorts Online, the check-in platform at LAN Airlines, and the component system behind Savings United’s campaign sites. I build with AI as the default: I direct the tools, review what they produce, and own what ships. Today I turn vague goals from founders and small teams into live sites such as base-pages.com and carma-retreats.com.
